entities.summary: Yakov Lvovich Malkiel was a Ukrainian-born American Romance etymologist and philologist. His specialty was the development of Latin words, roots, prefixes, and suffixes in modern Romance languages, particularly Spanish. He was the founder of the journal Romance Philology.
